title: Leveraging the Kaizen Methodology To Build Digital Skills in India Through Multistakeholder Partnerships

detail.title: Leveraging the Kaizen Methodology To Build Digital Skills in India Through Multistakeholder Partnerships
detail.abstract: India's rapidly expanding workforce faces a growing digital skills gap, with millions expected to require reskilling in AI and emerging technologies over the next decade. Addressing this at scale demands not just ambition but operational precision, particularly when delivery depends on complex multistakeholder partnerships spanning government, industry, and implementation partners. This white paper examines how the kaizen methodology was applied within such a partnership to continuously improve program design and delivery, ultimately enhancing both the effectiveness and efficiency of a national AI skilling initiative in India. Through three core kaizen tools, namely rose bud thorn design thinking, process gap analysis, and incident management with corrective action planning, the steering committee was able to systematically identify friction points, streamline learner registration, and resolve structural program issues in real time. The paper argues that kaizen offers a practical and adaptable framework for multi-stakeholder partnerships seeking to improve coordination, reduce operational waste, and maximise social impact at scale.

AI.tldr: 这篇白皮书探讨了如何在印度的国家AI技能培训计划中应用kaizen（持续改进）方法论，通过三种核心工具来改善多利益相关方合作，提升项目效率和效果。
AI.research_question: kaizen方法论如何应用于多利益相关方合作的国家AI技能培训计划，以改善项目设计和交付？
AI.motivation: 印度面临日益扩大的数字技能差距，未来十年需要对数百万劳动力进行AI和新兴技术再培训。大规模解决这一问题不仅需要雄心，更需要运营精度，特别是在依赖复杂的多利益相关方合作时。
AI.theoretical_framework: kaizen（持续改进）方法论，包括三种核心工具：rose bud thorn设计思维、流程差距分析、以及事件管理与纠正行动计划。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析印度国家AI技能培训计划中应用kaizen工具的实际经验，包括指导委员会如何系统识别摩擦点、简化学习者注册流程、实时解决结构性项目问题。
AI.findings: kaizen工具能够帮助多利益相关方合作系统识别运营问题，改善协调，减少浪费，提升项目效率和效果。具体表现在：1）系统识别摩擦点；2）简化学习者注册流程；3）实时解决结构性项目问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将kaizen方法论从制造业扩展到社会影响项目领域，特别是多利益相关方合作的大型技能培训项目，为运营管理理论提供了新的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府、行业和实施伙伴提供了实用的运营框架，帮助改善协调、减少运营浪费、最大化社会影响，特别是在大规模技能培训项目中。

title: Examination of the Emergence and Development of the Philosophy of Education in the Qom Seminary Over the Last Century
affiliations: and Research Institute of Hawzah and University

detail.title: Examination of the Emergence and Development of the Philosophy of Education in the Qom Seminary Over the Last Century
detail.abstract: Introduction and Objectives: Throughout history, Islamic seminaries (ḥawzah) have consistently undertaken the mission of promoting religion, ethics, spirituality, and the education of society, adapting their efforts to the conditions and available resources of each era. These seminaries trained the necessary human resources—including teachers, preachers, Imams of congregational prayers and Friday prayers—and through the establishment of schools and maktab-khānahs, contributed directly to the education of the public. A brief historical review shows that, in addition to educational activities, seminaries have played a pioneering role in research and knowledge production in the field of education, generating works on moral education, the ethics of teaching and learning, educational methods, and related topics. Since its reestablishment by Ḥājj Shaykh ʿAbd al-Karīm Ḥāʾerī, the Qom Seminary has paid serious attention to education and upbringing, acting in both theoretical and practical capacities. The aim of this article is to examine, from a historical perspective, the role of the Qom Seminary in shaping and developing the philosophy of education during the last cetury. The fundamental question addressed here is: What role has the Qom Seminary played over the last century in the emergence of the philosophy of education as an academic field, and through what developments has this process unfolded? Methodology: This study employs a historical–analytical method. Using documentary and library data, it investigates the emergence, evolution, and deepening of the philosophy of education in the Qom Seminary over the last cetury. By analyzing historical trends, official documents, published works from seminary, and institutional developments—such as the establishment of the Office for Seminary–University Cooperation—the theoretical and institutional trajectory of this development is reconstructed. The main focus is the analysis of scientific texts, policy documents, and major scholarly works from each historical period, in order to provide a systematic and comparative account of the growth of philosophy of education within this academic institution.

AI.tldr: 本文从历史视角考察了库姆神学院在过去一个世纪中在教育哲学形成与发展中的作用，分析了该机构如何通过理论研究和制度建设推动教育哲学作为学术领域的发展。
AI.research_question: 库姆神学院在过去一个世纪中在教育哲学作为学术领域的出现过程中扮演了什么角色？这一过程经历了哪些发展？
AI.motivation: 伊斯兰神学院历史上一直承担着促进宗教、伦理、灵性和社会教育的使命，库姆神学院自重建以来特别重视教育和培养工作，既有理论贡献也有实践行动，需要从历史角度系统考察其在教育哲学发展中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于伊斯兰教育传统和神学院的历史使命，结合教育哲学的理论框架，分析神学院在教育理论发展中的角色。
AI.method: 采用历史-分析方法，利用文献和图书馆资料，通过分析历史趋势、官方文件、神学院出版物和制度发展（如神学院-大学合作办公室的建立），重建教育哲学发展的理论和制度轨迹。
AI.findings: 研究发现库姆神学院在过去一个世纪中通过教育研究、知识生产、制度建设等多方面努力，在教育哲学的形成和发展中发挥了重要作用，推动了道德教育、教学伦理、教育方法等领域的理论发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）系统梳理了伊斯兰神学院在教育哲学发展中的历史角色；2）建立了神学院教育哲学发展的历史分析框架；3）揭示了宗教机构在现代教育理论发展中的独特作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）为伊斯兰教育机构的教育哲学建设提供历史经验；2）为神学院与大学的教育合作提供制度参考；3）为宗教教育机构的现代化转型提供实践启示。

title: The Perception Gap: How World Models Will Eliminate the Human-Mediated Input Layer in Enterprise Software

detail.title: The Perception Gap: How World Models Will Eliminate the Human-Mediated Input Layer in Enterprise Software
detail.abstract: Enterprise software encodes a five-decade structural assumption: human beings are the perception layer between the physical world and digital systems. This paper argues that this assumption-not any particular product feature-is the foundational architectural premise of an entire class of software, and that world models capable of directly perceiving physical environments will eliminate it. We introduce the Enterprise Software Perception Dependency Spectrum (EPDS), a framework classifying enterprise software by dependence on human perception as a primary input mechanism. Using Salesforce and Microsoft as representative cases, we map 22 product lines across three EPDS classes. We analyze how Meta's V-JEPA 2-achieving zero-shot robot planning from under 62 hours of unlabeled video-demonstrates that the perception layer is approaching enterprise viability. Finally, we propose the Business OS, a three-layer transitional architecture grounded in sociotechnical systems theory. Disruption will be asymmetric: vendors whose revenue concentrates in perception-dependent categories face elimination-level exposure, while digitally-native vendors are positioned to own the agent and governance layers of the emerging architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出企业软件存在一个结构性假设：人类是物理世界与数字系统之间的感知层。作者认为世界模型将消除这一假设，并引入企业软件感知依赖谱系（EPDS）框架，分析企业软件对人类感知的依赖程度。研究显示感知层正接近企业可用性，并提出基于社会技术系统理论的业务操作系统三层过渡架构。
AI.research_question: 世界模型直接感知物理环境的能力将如何颠覆企业软件的基础架构假设？
AI.motivation: 企业软件在过去五十年中一直基于一个核心假设：人类是连接物理世界与数字系统的感知层。随着AI世界模型的发展，这一假设即将被打破，需要重新思考企业软件的基础架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业软件感知依赖谱系（EPDS）框架、社会技术系统理论、三层过渡架构（业务操作系统）
AI.method: 案例研究法：以Salesforce和Microsoft为代表，将22个产品线映射到EPDS的三个类别；技术分析：评估Meta的V-JEPA 2模型在零样本机器人规划方面的能力
AI.findings: 1. 企业软件可分为三类：感知依赖型、感知增强型、感知无关型；2. Meta的V-JEPA 2仅用62小时未标记视频就能实现零样本机器人规划，表明感知层已接近企业可用性；3. 颠覆将是不对称的：依赖感知的供应商面临淘汰风险，而数字原生供应商将主导新兴架构的代理层和治理层
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出企业软件感知依赖谱系（EPDS）框架；2. 识别企业软件的基础架构假设；3. 构建基于社会技术系统理论的业务操作系统三层过渡架构
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业软件供应商提供战略定位框架；2. 为技术投资决策提供指导；3. 为组织架构转型提供路线图；4. 识别不同供应商的颠覆风险与机遇

title: Generative AI and Firm Hiring Demand: Evidence from Advanced and Developing Economies

detail.title: Generative AI and Firm Hiring Demand: Evidence from Advanced and Developing Economies
detail.abstract: We study how the release of ChatGPT in November 2022 affected firm hiring demand across 186 countries, using 77.8 million online job postings from 37,395 firmcountry pairs over 2021Q2-2025Q3. We construct predetermined firm-country AI exposure from 2019 occupational composition and estimate a continuous difference-in-differences design. The results reveal a divergent global adjustment. In advanced economies, posting volumes decline gradually beginning three to four quarters after ChatGPT's release, with compositional shifts toward fewer high-substitution vacancies emerging later. In developing economies, posting volumes begin to decline earlier in the event window, with compositional changes following by the third quarter. In both groups, more exposed firms reduce the share of high-substitution postings and lower the posting-weighted AI substitution mix, but the adjustment is faster and more front-loaded in developing economies. These patterns are consistent with generative AI reshaping hiring demand differently across development groups, with developing economies adjusting earlier and with clearer evidence on the composition margin than on overall posting volumes.

AI.tldr: 研究ChatGPT发布对全球186个国家企业招聘需求的影响，发现发达经济体和发展中经济体存在差异化的调整模式
AI.research_question: ChatGPT的发布如何影响不同发展水平经济体中企业的招聘需求？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI（特别是ChatGPT）的快速普及可能对劳动力市场产生深远影响，但不同发展水平经济体如何调整招聘需求尚不清楚
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI替代理论，使用职业构成构建企业-国家层面的AI暴露度指标
AI.method: 使用连续双重差分设计，分析2021Q2-2025Q3期间37,395个企业-国家对、7,780万在线招聘岗位数据
AI.findings: 1. 发达经济体：ChatGPT发布后3-4季度招聘量开始下降，高替代性岗位比例变化较晚出现；2. 发展中经济体：招聘量下降更早，第三季度就出现岗位构成变化；3. 高暴露企业都减少高替代性岗位比例，但发展中经济体调整更快更集中
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生成式AI对劳动力市场影响的异质性，提出了发展中经济体调整更早的理论解释框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定AI时代招聘策略、政策制定者设计劳动力市场干预措施提供实证依据，特别是针对不同发展水平经济体的差异化影响

title: Bias, Judgment, and Decision-Making in Modern Organizations: A CFO's Perspective

detail.title: Bias, Judgment, and Decision-Making in Modern Organizations: A CFO's Perspective

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This paper reflects independent research and professional experience.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or primary data collection. Any case illustrations are derived from professional experience and have been fully anonymized to protect confidentiality and privacy.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Decision-making in modern organizations is often assumed to be rational, data-driven, and objective. Yet, in practice, strategic choices are frequently shaped by cognitive biases, organizational pressures, and imperfect information. Drawing on over two decades of leadership experience in finance across diverse industries, this paper explores the gap between theoretical rationality and real-world decision-making. It builds on themes explored in Smart But Wrong (Muhammad, 2025), which examines how intelligent organizations arrive at flawed decisions due to biased interpretation of data and misplaced confidence in structured processes. The paper examines how biases manifest in areas such as hiring, strategy formulation, and financial judgment, and highlights the limitations of relying on data without contextual understanding. Through practical case illustrations, it demonstrates how both visible metrics and hidden dynamics shape outcomes. It further explores emerging challenges, including decision fatigue at senior leadership levels and the evolving role of artificial intelligence in influencing organizational choices. The paper argues for a more balanced approach that integrates analytical rigor with human judgment, ethical awareness, and contextual insight.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨了组织决策中理论理性与现实实践之间的差距，指出尽管现代组织决策被假定为理性、数据驱动和客观的，但实际上常受认知偏差、组织压力和不完美信息影响。基于作者20多年金融行业领导经验，论文分析了偏差在招聘、战略制定和财务判断中的表现，强调数据缺乏情境理解的局限性，并主张将分析严谨性与人类判断、伦理意识和情境洞察相结合。
AI.research_question: 组织决策中理论理性与现实实践之间的差距是如何形成的？认知偏差、组织压力和不完美信息如何影响战略决策的质量？
AI.motivation: 现代组织决策被假定为理性、数据驱动和客观的，但实践中战略选择常受认知偏差、组织压力和不完美信息影响。作者基于20多年金融行业领导经验，观察到智能组织因数据解释偏差和对结构化过程的过度自信而做出错误决策的现象，这促使研究理论理性与现实决策之间的差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Muhammad (2025)的《Smart But Wrong》中探讨的主题，该理论框架关注智能组织如何因数据解释偏差和对结构化过程的过度自信而做出错误决策。论文结合行为决策理论、认知偏差理论以及组织行为学视角，分析理性决策模型的局限性。
AI.method: 基于作者20多年金融行业跨行业领导经验的实践观察，采用案例研究方法，通过实际案例说明可见指标和隐藏动态如何共同影响决策结果。论文还探讨了新兴挑战，包括高层领导决策疲劳和人工智能在影响组织选择中的演变作用。
AI.findings: 认知偏差在招聘、战略制定和财务判断等多个领域显著影响决策质量；单纯依赖数据而缺乏情境理解存在严重局限性；可见指标和隐藏动态共同塑造决策结果；高层领导面临决策疲劳挑战；人工智能正在改变组织决策过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了行为决策理论在组织环境中的应用，深化了对理性决策模型局限性的理解，为智能组织错误决策机制提供了理论解释，丰富了认知偏差在战略决策中作用的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织决策者提供了识别和减轻认知偏差的实用框架；倡导将分析严谨性与人类判断、伦理意识和情境洞察相结合的平衡方法；帮助组织更好地应对决策疲劳和人工智能带来的新挑战；提供了改进招聘、战略制定和财务判断决策的具体建议。

title: Governing the Social Vacuum: How Vulnerability and Social Norms Shape Prosocial Behavior in Unsupervised Service Environments
affiliations: Wuhan University - Economics and Management School, Arizona State University (ASU) - W.P. Carey School of Business, Arizona State University (ASU) and Wuhan University

detail.title: Governing the Social Vacuum: How Vulnerability and Social Norms Shape Prosocial Behavior in Unsupervised Service Environments
detail.abstract: Robotic agents increasingly operate in unsupervised service environments, yet the resulting "social vacuum" often lowers the threshold for human abuse and neglect. To address this governance challenge, we investigate and compare two distinct behavioral interventions: social norm appeals (reconstructing social constraints) and revealing AI vulnerability (acknowledging a competence gap). Across a largescale randomized field experiment with a leading robotaxi firm operating at scale, and a controlled laboratory experiment, we find that both strategies significantly reduce antisocial behavior (littering). However, our results reveal that they operate through fundamentally different psychological pathways with distinct boundary conditions. Social norm appeals function through a logic of compliance. Field analyses show that this strategy is fragile under environmental stress (e.g., adverse weather), which depletes cognitive resources. Further analyses also suggest that riders exposed to such appeals may exhibit a slight reduction in their willingness to take a subsequent ride. In contrast, revealing AI vulnerability operates through a logic of empowerment; by highlighting the user's unique capacity to help, it awakens prosocial efficacy, remaining robust regardless of external stressors. Our laboratory experiment validates these distinct mechanisms, confirming that social norm appeals operate via descriptive norms while AI vulnerability signals operate via perceived prosocial impact. Finally, we uncover a substitution effect: combining these strategies yields no synergistic benefit in a field setting, suggesting that firms can leverage these distinct psychological levers as a strategic portfolio to effectively manage the social vacuum of automation.

AI.tldr: 研究通过实地实验和实验室实验比较了两种减少机器人服务环境中反社会行为的干预策略：社会规范呼吁和揭示AI脆弱性。两种策略都能有效减少乱扔垃圾行为，但通过不同的心理机制起作用，且具有不同的边界条件。
AI.research_question: 在机器人服务环境中，社会规范呼吁和揭示AI脆弱性这两种行为干预策略如何影响用户的反社会行为？它们通过什么心理机制起作用，有哪些边界条件？
AI.motivation: 机器人代理越来越多地在无人监督的服务环境中运行，这种"社会真空"降低了人类虐待和忽视机器人的门槛，需要有效的治理策略来减少反社会行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会规范理论（描述性规范）、AI脆弱性理论、认知资源理论、亲社会效能理论、行为干预理论
AI.method: 1. 大规模随机实地实验：与领先的机器人出租车公司合作进行实地研究；2. 受控实验室实验：验证心理机制和边界条件
AI.findings: 1. 两种策略都能显著减少乱扔垃圾行为；2. 社会规范呼吁通过遵从逻辑起作用，但在环境压力下（如恶劣天气）效果脆弱；3. 揭示AI脆弱性通过赋权逻辑起作用，不受外部压力影响；4. 两种策略没有协同效应，可以组合使用作为战略组合
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分了两种减少机器人服务环境中反社会行为的心理机制：遵从逻辑vs赋权逻辑；2. 揭示了社会规范呼吁的认知资源边界条件；3. 提出了AI脆弱性通过亲社会效能起作用的机制；4. 发现了两种干预策略的替代效应而非协同效应
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供了管理自动化社会真空的有效策略组合；2. 指导在不同环境条件下选择合适的干预策略；3. 帮助设计更有效的机器人服务行为干预方案；4. 为AI伦理和治理提供实践指导

title: Managing Regulatory Enforcement Risk In Employment-Based Immigration: A Systems-Based Governance Framework For Institutional Accountability

detail.title: Managing Regulatory Enforcement Risk In Employment-Based Immigration: A Systems-Based Governance Framework For Institutional Accountability
detail.abstract:
Employment-based immigration in the United States operates within a complex and highly regulated environment that exposes organizations to significant regulatory enforcement risk. Employers sponsoring foreign workers must comply with overlapping requirements enforced by agencies such as the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, Department of Labor, and Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Despite the critical importance of compliance, many organizations continue to rely on fragmented, manual processes that increase the likelihood of errors, missed deadlines, and audit exposure. This study addresses this gap by examining how regulatory enforcement risk can be mitigated through a systems-based approach to institutional accountability.

The study adopts a conceptual research design supported by a structured review of interdisciplinary literature spanning regulatory governance, institutional theory, and information systems. Through conceptual synthesis, the study develops an integrated theoretical framework linking regulatory pressures, risk governance mechanisms, and information systems capabilities. Building on this foundation, a systems governance framework is proposed to operationalize compliance as a lifecycle-based, technology-enabled, and continuously monitored process.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个基于系统的治理框架，通过技术赋能和持续监控来降低美国就业移民中的监管执法风险。
AI.research_question: 如何通过基于系统的制度问责方法来减轻美国就业移民中的监管执法风险？
AI.motivation: 美国就业移民环境复杂且监管严格，组织面临重大执法风险。许多组织仍依赖分散的手动流程，导致错误、错过截止日期和审计风险增加。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合监管治理、制度理论和信息系统的跨学科理论框架，连接监管压力、风险治理机制和信息系统能力。
AI.method: 概念性研究设计，支持以结构化方式审查跨学科文献，包括监管治理、制度理论和信息系统，通过概念综合构建理论框架。
AI.findings: 提出一个系统治理框架，将合规操作化为基于生命周期、技术赋能和持续监控的过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一个整合监管压力、风险治理机制和信息系统能力的综合理论框架，扩展了制度问责理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了一个实用的系统治理框架，通过技术赋能和持续监控来改善就业移民合规管理，降低执法风险。

title: Managers and the Persistence of Productivity

detail.title: Managers and the Persistence of Productivity
detail.abstract: Standard two-way fixed effects models assume that a manager's effect on performance is fully realized upon assignment. We develop a framework in which plant output depends on a latent managerial stock that depreciates at rate δ and is replenished by the current manager's productivity. We prove that δ is point-identified and that ignoring persistence understates both managerial productivity dispersion and the variance share attributable to managers. Applying our framework to CEO data, we estimate low persistence for profitability (δ ≈ 0.21) but high persistence for firm scale (δ ≈ 0.73 for sales, δ ≈ 0.78 for employment), implying that the standard variance decomposition understates the dispersion of CEO effects on firm scale by 50-60 percent. We then show in two political economy settings that ignoring persistence substantially understates the estimated effects of reforms that change how leaders are selected: the long-run cost of patronage in the British Empire is roughly 4 times the static estimate, and the quality differential from discretionary appointment in Qing China is 2.4 times larger.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个考虑管理者效应持续性的框架，证明忽略持续性会低估管理者生产率分散度和管理者贡献的方差份额。应用于CEO数据发现，盈利能力的持续性低但企业规模的持续性高，标准方差分解低估了CEO对企业规模影响的分散度50-60%。在政治经济应用中，忽略持续性会大幅低估改革效果。
AI.research_question: 如何准确估计管理者效应对组织绩效的持续影响？忽略管理者效应的持续性如何影响对管理者生产率分散度和管理者贡献方差份额的估计？
AI.motivation: 传统的双向固定效应模型假设管理者对绩效的影响在任命时立即完全实现，忽略了管理者效应可能具有持续性（即管理者离开后其影响仍会持续）。这种忽略可能导致对管理者生产率分散度和管理者贡献的方差份额的低估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 管理者存量框架：将工厂产出建模为依赖于一个潜在的管理者存量，该存量以δ速率折旧，并由当前管理者的生产率补充。2. 持续性识别理论：证明了持续性参数δ是点识别的。3. 方差分解理论：展示了忽略持续性会低估管理者生产率分散度和管理者贡献的方差份额。
AI.method: 1. 理论框架开发：构建管理者存量模型，其中产出依赖于折旧的管理者存量。2. 识别证明：数学证明持续性参数δ的点识别性。3. 实证应用：将框架应用于CEO数据（盈利能力和企业规模）和两个政治经济案例（英帝国庇护制和清朝官员任命）。
AI.findings: 1. CEO数据：盈利能力的持续性低（δ≈0.21），但企业规模的持续性高（销售δ≈0.73，就业δ≈0.78）。2. 标准方差分解低估了CEO对企业规模影响的分散度50-60%。3. 政治经济应用：忽略持续性会大幅低估改革效果（英帝国庇护制的长期成本是静态估计的4倍，清朝官员任命的质量差异是2.4倍）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了一个考虑管理者效应持续性的理论框架。2. 证明了持续性参数δ的点识别性。3. 理论证明了忽略持续性会低估管理者生产率分散度和管理者贡献的方差份额。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为准确估计管理者效应提供了方法论工具。2. 揭示了CEO对企业规模影响具有高度持续性。3. 在政策评估中强调了考虑持续性的重要性（如官员任命改革的效果评估）。4. 为组织设计和领导力评估提供了更准确的测量框架。

title: The End of the Feed: Sovereign Narrative Experience and the Case for AI-Assisted Discovery and Continuation

detail.title: The End of the Feed: Sovereign Narrative Experience and the Case for AI-Assisted Discovery and Continuation
detail.abstract: Recommendation algorithms are structurally incapable of understanding why a person responds to a work of art. They match metadata to metadata: genre tags, viewing history, demographic proxies. They cannot see the thread connecting three apparently unlike things a person loves, because that thread is not a category. It is a ratio of qualities-dread and beauty, formal precision and emotional devastation, the uncanny made domestic. This paper argues that AI-assisted discovery and continuation represents a qualitatively different relationship between a person and their narrative experience. The first claim is that conversational AI can identify aesthetic threads that algorithms cannot, because conversation operates on meaning rather than metadata. The second and more radical claim is that AI may enable sovereign narrative continuation: the extension of stories that were structurally complete but infrastructurally abandoned. Cancelled shows, unfinished mythologies, and truncated narrative arcs are reframed here as medium shocks-coordination failures in the delivery infrastructure, not in the story itself. The ratio that made them resonant can keep running. The instrument for continuing it now exists.

AI.tldr: 本文认为AI辅助的发现与延续代表了人与叙事体验之间质的差异关系：对话式AI能识别算法无法发现的美学线索，并能实现"主权叙事延续"——延续那些结构完整但因基础设施问题被中断的故事。
AI.research_question: AI如何通过对话识别传统推荐算法无法发现的美学线索，并实现被中断叙事的主权延续？
AI.motivation: 传统推荐算法基于元数据匹配，无法理解艺术作品吸引人的深层美学原因，而对话式AI能基于意义而非元数据进行理解，为叙事体验提供全新可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 美学线索理论：艺术作品吸引人的深层美学比例关系；2. 主权叙事延续理论：故事结构完整但因基础设施中断的延续可能性；3. 媒介冲击理论：叙事交付基础设施的协调失败而非故事本身问题。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，通过概念论证和理论构建，分析对话式AI与传统推荐算法的本质差异及其在叙事延续中的应用潜力。
AI.findings: 对话式AI能识别传统算法无法发现的美学线索，并能实现被取消剧集、未完成神话、中断叙事弧的主权延续，这些中断是媒介基础设施问题而非故事本身缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出美学线索识别的新理论框架；2. 建立主权叙事延续的理论模型；3. 发展媒介冲击作为协调失败的理论概念；4. 为AI在叙事体验中的角色提供新理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为内容推荐系统提供新的设计思路；2. 为被中断叙事的延续提供技术可能性；3. 为创作者和观众之间的互动创造新范式；4. 为文化遗产的数字化延续提供新方法。

title: Building Audit-Ready Immigration Sponsorship Systems: A Documentation Governance Framework For Employers In Uganda

detail.title: Building Audit-Ready Immigration Sponsorship Systems: A Documentation Governance Framework For Employers In Uganda
detail.abstract: Work permit processing delays and weak audit readiness remain persistent challenges for organizations managing expatriate employees in Uganda. While these challenges are often attributed to external regulatory inefficiencies, this study argues that a significant proportion of delays originate from internal organizational practices, particularly the absence of structured documentation governance systems. This study adopts a conceptual and qualitative approach to examine how fragmented documentation processes, inconsistent record management, and weak accountability mechanisms contribute to compliance gaps and operational inefficiencies in immigration sponsorship. Drawing on Institutional Theory, Documentation Governance Theory, and Information Systems Governance, the study develops a comprehensive framework that reconceptualizes immigration sponsorship as a governance and systems-driven process. The findings reveal that documentation fragmentation, lack of standardization, limited use of compliance tracking tools, and weak escalation mechanisms are key factors undermining both audit readiness and processing efficiency. In response, the study proposes a Documentation Governance System Framework that integrates lifecycle-based process management, compliance matrices, escalation frameworks, and system integration to support structured and proactive compliance. The proposed framework emphasizes practical applicability within the Ugandan context, demonstrating how organizations can leverage existing tools such as spreadsheets, shared drives, and basic digital systems to implement governance mechanisms without requiring extensive technological investment. By improving documentation accuracy, enhancing accountability, and enabling real-time monitoring of compliance activities, the framework offers a scalable solution for reducing processing delays and strengthening audit readiness.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个文档治理系统框架，通过整合生命周期流程管理、合规矩阵和升级机制，帮助乌干达组织减少外籍员工工作许可处理延迟并增强审计准备度。
AI.research_question: 乌干达组织内部文档治理实践如何影响外籍员工工作许可处理延迟和审计准备度？
AI.motivation: 工作许可处理延迟和审计准备度不足是乌干达管理外籍员工组织面临的持续挑战，这些挑战通常归因于外部监管效率低下，但本研究认为大部分延迟源于内部组织实践，特别是缺乏结构化文档治理系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、文档治理理论、信息系统治理理论
AI.method: 概念性和质性研究方法，通过分析碎片化文档流程、不一致记录管理和薄弱问责机制来检验其对合规差距和运营效率的影响
AI.findings: 文档碎片化、缺乏标准化、合规跟踪工具使用有限、升级机制薄弱是削弱审计准备度和处理效率的关键因素
AI.theory_contributions: 将移民赞助重新概念化为治理和系统驱动的过程，开发了一个整合生命周期流程管理、合规矩阵、升级框架和系统集成的综合框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出文档治理系统框架，强调在乌干达背景下的实际适用性，展示组织如何利用现有工具（如电子表格、共享驱动器和基本数字系统）实施治理机制，无需大量技术投资

reference: MIT Sloan Research Paper No. 7376-26
title: Deep-Tech Innovation: A Multi-Method Study toward a Conceptual Framework and Research Agenda
affiliations: University of Münster, , University of Münster, Bern University of Applied Sciences (BFH), University of Münster and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Entrepreneurship Center

detail.title: Deep-Tech Innovation: A Multi-Method Study toward a Conceptual Framework and Research Agenda

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Schweizer Nationalfonds (SNSF, Swiss National Science Foundation) – Project number 219845 and the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) – Project number 531021081.

publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Sloan School of Management Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The term "deep-tech innovation" has attracted growing attention in research and practice, but it is applied inconsistently and lacks an agreed-upon definition. This limits cumulative knowledge building and blurs how deep-tech innovation relates to adjacent concepts. We address this gap by developing a framework that treats deep-tech innovation as a distinct object of inquiry. Using a multi-method design that combines a systematic, integrative, conceptcentric literature review and semi-structured interviews with deep-tech founders, we identify twelve defining attributes structured across three levels: invention, venture, and ecosystem. At the invention level (the conceptual core), we specify six attributes: three foundational attributes that capture the scientific and technological basis of the invention (scientific origins, hardware intensity, and an enabling platform character), and three attributes that describe its characteristic exposure profile (long development timelines, high capital intensity, and multilayered uncertainty). The remaining six attributes capture recurring implications at the venture level (staged financing strategies, dual scientific and commercial maturation, and the multidisciplinary broadening of teams) and the ecosystem level (multi-actor interactions, specialized incubation support, and industrial de-risking and scaling partnerships). We use this framework to delineate the boundaries of deep-tech innovation, distinguish it from adjacent concepts, and propose an agenda for future research.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过多方法研究开发了一个框架，将深度技术创新定义为具有12个属性的独特研究对象，这些属性分布在发明、企业和生态系统三个层面，从而澄清了该概念的定义和边界。
AI.research_question: 如何定义和界定"深度技术创新"这一概念？深度技术创新具有哪些关键属性？如何将其与相邻概念区分开来？
AI.motivation: "深度技术创新"一词在研究和实践中受到越来越多的关注，但应用不一致且缺乏公认的定义，这限制了知识的积累，并模糊了深度技术创新与相邻概念的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将深度技术创新视为独特的研究对象，从三个层面构建理论框架：发明层面（概念核心）、企业层面和生态系统层面。
AI.method: 采用多方法设计：结合系统的、整合的、以概念为中心的文献综述，以及对深度技术创始人的半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: 识别出12个定义属性，分布在三个层面：发明层面（6个属性：科学起源、硬件强度、平台特性、长开发周期、高资本密集度、多层次不确定性）；企业层面（3个属性：分阶段融资策略、科学与商业双重成熟、团队多学科扩展）；生态系统层面（3个属性：多参与者互动、专业孵化支持、工业去风险和规模化合作）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为深度技术创新提供了清晰的定义框架；2. 明确了深度技术创新的边界，区分了其与相邻概念；3. 提出了未来研究议程；4. 促进了该领域的知识积累。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为深度技术创业者提供指导框架；2. 帮助投资者和政策制定者更好地理解和支持深度技术创新；3. 为生态系统参与者提供合作框架；4. 促进深度技术创新生态系统的发展。

title: From Apparent AI Efficiency to Realized Productivity: Verification Friction in AI-Augmented Knowledge Work

detail.title: From Apparent AI Efficiency to Realized Productivity: Verification Friction in AI-Augmented Knowledge Work
detail.abstract: Generative AI can produce visible gains in speed and performance, but those gains do not translate cleanly into realized productivity in accountable knowledge work. Current productivity studies typically capture aggregate performance outcomes, while research shows that workers often spend additional effort checking, interpreting, and correcting AI output. This paper develops a conceptual bridge across information systems, human–computer interaction, and economics literatures to address this gap. In the underlying mechanism, AI factual unreliability increases cognitive verification load, while LLM literacy shapes how efficiently the burden is managed. The paper introduces verification friction as the episode-level economic cost that arises when the constraint pathway becomes consequential in AI-assisted work. It also develops a measurement bridge for situations where human-with-AI time is recorded as a single on-platform interval. In those cases, apparent gross savings can overstate realized gains because some verification and correction occur outside the recorded interaction. The result is a framework for distinguishing visible AI acceleration from burden-adjusted realized value.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了生成式AI在知识工作中看似提升效率，但实际上由于AI事实不可靠性带来的认知验证负担，导致实际生产力增益被高估的现象。论文提出了"验证摩擦"概念来解释这一差距。
AI.research_question: 为什么生成式AI在知识工作中看似提升速度和性能，但这些增益不能完全转化为实际生产力？如何解释和衡量AI辅助工作中的验证负担对实际价值的影响？
AI.motivation: 当前生产力研究通常只捕捉总体绩效结果，但研究表明工作者需要花费额外精力检查、解释和修正AI输出。现有研究未能充分解释AI事实不可靠性如何影响实际生产力增益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合信息系统、人机交互和经济学文献，提出AI事实不可靠性增加认知验证负荷，而LLM素养影响负担管理效率的理论框架。引入"验证摩擦"作为AI辅助工作中约束路径产生的经济成本。
AI.method: 开发概念桥梁和测量桥梁，特别针对人机交互时间被记录为单一平台区间的情况。建立区分可见AI加速与负担调整后实际价值的分析框架。
AI.findings: 明显的总节约可能高估实际增益，因为部分验证和修正发生在记录交互之外。AI事实不可靠性增加认知验证负荷，而LLM素养影响验证效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出验证摩擦概念作为AI辅助工作的经济成本；2) 建立跨学科理论框架解释AI生产力悖论；3) 提供区分可见加速与实际价值的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 帮助组织更准确评估AI投资回报；2) 为设计减少验证摩擦的AI系统提供指导；3) 强调LLM素养培训的重要性；4) 提供测量AI实际生产力的方法论工具。

title: AI Washing: How Firms Use Artificial Intelligence Narratives to Mask Offshoring, Recessionary Cost-Cutting, and Post-Pandemic Restructuring

detail.title: AI Washing: How Firms Use Artificial Intelligence Narratives to Mask Offshoring, Recessionary Cost-Cutting, and Post-Pandemic Restructuring

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relied on publicly available documentary sources. No human subjects research was conducted.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: In 2025, artificial intelligence was cited as the cause in 54,836 layoffs, culminating in Block, Inc.'s February 2026 elimination of approximately 4,000 positions attributed to "intelligence tools." Yet Block's own CEO had explicitly denied AI as a layoff driver eleven months earlier, and the company's headcount reduction returned staffing to pre-pandemic levels that predated any of the cited AI tools. Independent evidence from executive surveys, technology assessments, and legally mandated layoff disclosures consistently finds that the AI capabilities firms cite to investors are not reflected in any other evidence channel. This article argues that AI washing, the strategic practice of attributing workforce reductions to artificial intelligence capabilities that did not cause them, functions as a multi-layered narrative whose documentary traces are consistent with three convergent restructuring forces: offshoring of white-collar positions, recessionary cost-cutting driven by tariffs and credit tightening, and correction of pandemic-era over-hiring. Drawing on institutional theory, signaling theory, and the greenwashing literature, the article develops a Triple Concealment Model identifying these forces and proposes signal quality inversion as a mechanism explaining why capital markets reward unverified AI claims. A documentary analysis across six independent evidence categories provides the empirical foundation. The article offers a five-question diagnostic framework enabling boards, investors, and workforce leaders to distinguish genuine AI transformation from strategic narrative packaging.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，企业将裁员归因于人工智能（AI）的现象往往是"AI漂洗"策略，即用AI作为裁员理由来掩盖真实的裁员动因（如离岸外包、经济衰退成本削减、疫情后招聘过度修正）。
AI.research_question: 企业为何将裁员归因于人工智能，这种"AI漂洗"现象背后的真实动因是什么？资本市场为何会奖励未经核实的AI声明？
AI.motivation: 2025年有54,836个裁员案例被归因于AI，但实际证据显示这些AI能力并未在其他证据渠道中得到反映。企业CEO公开否认AI是裁员驱动因素，而裁员规模只是恢复到疫情前水平。这种矛盾现象需要解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、信号理论、绿色漂洗文献，并提出了三重隐瞒模型和信号质量倒置机制。
AI.method: 跨六个独立证据类别的文件分析，包括高管调查、技术评估、法律要求的裁员披露等。
AI.findings: 企业将裁员归因于AI的现象与三种趋同的重组力量一致：白领职位离岸外包、关税和信贷紧缩驱动的衰退性成本削减、疫情时期过度招聘的修正。资本市场会奖励未经核实的AI声明。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了三重隐瞒模型，识别了AI漂洗背后的三种真实力量；提出了信号质量倒置机制，解释资本市场为何奖励未经核实的AI声明。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个五问题诊断框架，使董事会、投资者和劳动力领导者能够区分真正的AI转型与战略叙事包装。

title: The Sweet Caroline Invariant: 45 Seconds of Functional Resonance in High-Variance Systems

detail.title: The Sweet Caroline Invariant: 45 Seconds of Functional Resonance in High-Variance Systems
detail.abstract: This paper examines a recurring collective synchronization event observable in large-scale human gatherings: the approximately 45-second window during which a crowd singing Sweet Caroline achieves measurable behavioral coherence. The event is typically credited to the song's cultural popularity or emotional resonance. This paper proposes a different account. The mechanism appears to be structural rather than sentimental: a specific ratio of constraint and variance imposed on a high-noise system, producing brief but reliable collective alignment. The song is not the cause. It is the delivery mechanism for a ratio that the system was already capable of achieving. The distinction matters because it suggests that collective coordination at scale does not require shared belief, shared narrative, or any particular cultural content. It requires a correctly structured anchor. This specimen may be one of the most widely replicated unrecognized demonstrations of the Coordination Invariant (S = C/V) in recorded human behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出，人群在合唱《Sweet Caroline》时出现的45秒集体同步现象，并非源于歌曲的文化流行度或情感共鸣，而是由特定约束与方差比例（S = C/V）在嘈杂系统中产生的结构性机制所致。
AI.research_question: 大规模人群集会中可观察到的集体同步事件（如合唱《Sweet Caroline》时的45秒窗口期）的根本机制是什么？是文化情感因素还是结构性因素？
AI.motivation: 传统上将此类集体同步归因于歌曲的文化流行度或情感共鸣，但作者认为需要探究其背后的结构性机制，以理解大规模集体协调的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协调不变量理论（Coordination Invariant）：S = C/V，即集体同步（S）由约束（C）与方差（V）的特定比例决定。
AI.method: 通过分析大规模人群集会中合唱《Sweet Caroline》时出现的约45秒集体同步窗口期这一现象，作为实证案例进行研究。
AI.findings: 集体同步现象并非由歌曲本身的文化或情感内容引起，而是由特定约束与方差比例在嘈杂系统中产生的结构性机制所致。歌曲只是传递这一比例的载体。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了协调不变量理论（S = C/V）在人类行为中的实证证据；2. 挑战了传统上认为集体协调需要共享信念、叙事或文化内容的观点；3. 表明大规模集体协调只需要正确结构的锚点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解和管理大规模人群行为提供了新视角；2. 表明集体协调可以通过结构性设计而非文化内容来实现；3. 为活动组织、人群管理等实践领域提供了理论指导。

title: Cartel Persistence as an Equilibrium Outcome of Enforcement Design

detail.title: Cartel Persistence as an Equilibrium Outcome of Enforcement Design
detail.abstract: This article develops an analytical economic framework to explain cartel formation and persistence as equilibrium outcomes of market structure and enforcement design. Rather than treating cartels as isolated legal violations, the framework models collusion as a rational response to concentrated market structures, repeated interaction, and imperfect enforcement technologies. The analysis emphasizes how detection probability, sanction design, and institutional capacity jointly shape firms' incentives to sustain or abandon collusive equilibria. Within this setting, traditional sanction-based deterrence may fail to destabilize cartels when structural conditions favor coordination. The framework yields clear comparative statics regarding the effects of market concentration, transparency, and enforcement credibility on cartel stability. These results generate testable implications for the design of antitrust enforcement, including the role of leniency programs and proactive market screening. By integrating insights from industrial organization and deterrence economics, the article contributes to the law and economics literature on cartel enforcement and institutional design.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个分析性经济框架，将卡特尔形成和持续解释为市场结构和执法设计的均衡结果，强调市场集中度、执法技术和制度能力如何共同影响企业维持或放弃合谋的动机。
AI.research_question: 市场结构和执法设计如何共同影响卡特尔的形成和持续性？
AI.motivation: 传统上卡特尔被视为孤立的法律违规行为，但本文认为合谋是企业对市场结构、重复互动和不完善执法技术的理性反应，需要从均衡角度理解卡特尔现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合产业组织理论和威慑经济学，构建分析性经济框架，将卡特尔视为市场结构和执法设计的均衡结果。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，分析市场集中度、透明度、执法可信度等因素如何影响卡特尔稳定性，推导出可检验的比较静态结果。
AI.findings: 当结构性条件有利于协调时，传统的基于制裁的威慑可能无法瓦解卡特尔；市场集中度、透明度和执法可信度对卡特尔稳定性有明确影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为卡特尔执法和制度设计的法律经济学文献做出贡献，整合产业组织和威慑经济学的见解，提供解释卡特尔形成和持续性的均衡框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断执法设计提供可检验的政策启示，包括宽大处理计划和主动市场筛查的作用。

title: The Map Inversion: A Shared Puzzle About How We See the World - And What Becomes Possible When We Look From Outside

detail.title: The Map Inversion: A Shared Puzzle About How We See the World - And What Becomes Possible When We Look From Outside
detail.abstract: This paper invites consideration of a structural shift in how human behavioral systems are interpretedmoving from an internal, moral-evaluative map to an external, mechanical lens. By viewing the human instrument as a system regulated by the balance of constraint and variance, recurring patterns of "looping" (blame, guilt, and retrospective rewriting) become visible as predictable systemic noise rather than personal or collective failure. The Coordination Invariant S = C/V (developed across a broader body of work and formalized in the March 2026 capstone "Consciousness as a Ratio") offers one way to see this. The paper introduces the concept of the "Map Inversion"-a move toward participatory objectivity through stable, shared external references. This shift appears to enable forward-moving systemic alignment without the necessity of correcting past states, with possible implications for coordination in interpersonal, organizational, and technological systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从内在道德评价视角转向外在机械视角来解读人类行为系统，将人类视为受约束与变异平衡调节的系统，将"循环"模式（责备、内疚、回溯重写）视为可预测的系统噪声而非个人失败。通过协调不变量S=C/V和"地图反转"概念，实现参与式客观性，促进系统协调而无需修正过去状态。
AI.research_question: 如何通过从内在道德评价视角转向外在机械视角来重新解释人类行为系统，从而更有效地促进人际、组织和科技系统的协调？
AI.motivation: 传统上对人类行为的解释过于依赖内在道德评价，导致责备、内疚和回溯重写等"循环"模式被视为个人或集体失败。这种视角限制了系统协调效率，需要寻找更客观、机械的解释框架来促进系统对齐。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 系统调节理论：将人类行为系统视为受约束(C)与变异(V)平衡调节的系统；2. 协调不变量S=C/V理论；3. 地图反转概念：从内在主观视角转向稳定共享的外部参考框架；4. 参与式客观性理论。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于理论推导和概念构建。通过引入协调不变量S=C/V（来自2026年3月"意识作为比率"的总结性工作）和地图反转概念，建立新的解释框架。
AI.findings: 1. 责备、内疚和回溯重写等"循环"模式可重新解释为可预测的系统噪声而非道德失败；2. 地图反转能够实现参与式客观性；3. 这种视角转变能够促进前向系统对齐，无需修正过去状态；4. 对人际、组织和科技系统的协调具有积极意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出人类行为系统解释的结构性转变框架；2. 发展协调不变量S=C/V的理论应用；3. 引入"地图反转"概念；4. 建立参与式客观性的理论框架；5. 为系统协调提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为减少人际冲突中的责备和内疚提供实践框架；2. 为组织管理中的系统协调提供新方法；3. 为科技系统设计提供人类行为理解的新视角；4. 促进更有效的跨系统协调实践。

title: Robust Assortment Optimization With Value Conscious Customers Under Nested Logit Model
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Department of Data and Systems Engineering, The University of Hong Kong and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

detail.title: Robust Assortment Optimization With Value Conscious Customers Under Nested Logit Model
detail.abstract: We study the assortment optimization problem under the nested logit choice model where its estimated utilities of products and estimated dissimilarity factors of nests are uncertain and both lie in rectangular uncertainty sets. Under competitive alternatives and fully captured nests settings, the objective is to find a robust assortment such that the worst-case expected revenue is maximized. We show that, when the estimated utilities satisfy a proposed revenue-utility conscious (RUC) condition (a weaker version of the "value conscious" condition), the robust assortment optimization problem can be transformed into an equivalent tractable linear program with both estimated utilities and dissimilarity factors chosen as their lower bounds. In that case, nested-by-revenue assortment attains optimality. We also demonstrate that the size of the robust assortment grows monotonically as utility uncertainty expands, yet it behaves non-monotonically with respect to the dissimilarity factors. Our results provide guidelines for practitioners to make robust assortment decisions under distinct sources of parameter uncertainties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究嵌套logit选择模型下的产品组合优化问题，其中产品效用估计值和巢的相异因子估计值都存在不确定性。在竞争性替代品和完全捕获巢设置下，目标是找到使最坏情况期望收益最大化的稳健产品组合。研究表明，当估计效用满足提出的收益-效用意识（RUC）条件时，稳健产品组合优化问题可转化为等价的可处理线性规划，且最优解为按收益排序的嵌套产品组合。
AI.research_question: 在嵌套logit选择模型中，当产品效用和巢相异因子都存在不确定性时，如何找到使最坏情况期望收益最大化的稳健产品组合？
AI.motivation: 实际应用中，产品效用和巢相异因子的估计值往往存在不确定性，这会影响产品组合决策的质量。需要开发能够在参数不确定性下做出稳健决策的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 嵌套logit选择模型、稳健优化理论、收益-效用意识（RUC）条件、竞争性替代品和完全捕获巢设置。
AI.method: 将稳健产品组合优化问题转化为等价的可处理线性规划，分析在RUC条件下最优解的特性，研究产品组合规模随效用不确定性和相异因子变化的行为。
AI.findings: 1. 当估计效用满足RUC条件时，稳健产品组合优化问题可转化为线性规划，且最优解为按收益排序的嵌套产品组合；2. 稳健产品组合规模随效用不确定性扩大而单调增长；3. 产品组合规模随相异因子的变化呈非单调性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了RUC条件作为"价值意识"条件的弱化版本；2. 证明了在RUC条件下，稳健产品组合优化问题可转化为线性规划；3. 揭示了产品组合规模随不同参数不确定性变化的规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者在不同参数不确定性来源下做出稳健的产品组合决策提供了指导：1. 在RUC条件下可采用按收益排序的嵌套产品组合；2. 效用不确定性扩大时应增加产品组合规模；3. 相异因子变化对产品组合规模的影响需要谨慎评估。

title: The Voice of Fairness in Humanitarian Logistics
affiliations: , , Tsinghua University, Sheffield University Management School and School of Economics and Management, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

detail.title: The Voice of Fairness in Humanitarian Logistics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to mention
declarations.ethicsApproval: Nothing to mention
declarations.funderStatement: Nothing to mention

detail.abstract: The increasing frequency of natural disasters poses unprecedented challenges to humanitarian relief networks. Worse still, inaccurate budgeting and demand misestimation in pre-disaster planning often exacerbate post-disaster inequitable outcomes. We study a humanitarian relief prepositioning problem under demand uncertainty, where a decision maker determines facility locations and inventory levels subject to a fairnessaware budget. The problem is formulated as a predictive Wasserstein distributionally robust model, with the ambiguity set constructed from available data and a demand prediction model. A key novelty of this study is a far-sighted and unified criterion, termed the "Voice of Fairness" (VoF), which "speaks up" for the relative importance of fairness versus operational expenditure. The VoF admits an insightful representation that coherently integrates the budget, predicted expected operational cost, unfairness, and ambiguity effect. By maximizing the VoF, the decision maker can transparently navigate the optimal fairness-cost tradeoff within the budget. The structure of the VoF permits a convex reformulation of the second-stage fairness-aware transportation problem, thereby allowing the model to be solved efficiently via bisection search. Sensitivity analysis shows that the optimal VoF is increasing and convex in both budget and prediction accuracy, offering clear guidance to decision makers: Improving these parameters not only directly mitigates unfairness but also expands the solution space for a more favorable fairness vs. operational cost balance. Finite-sample guarantees are further established for the out-of-sample VoF, and its convergence to the true optimum is characterized. Numerical experiments on the Yushu earthquake and Super Typhoon Karding demonstrate the practical value of our approach: Through the lens of VoF, our budgetary framework reduces expected unfairness (e.g., by 65.16%) and fairness-aware total cost (e.g., by 11.33%) with moderate operational cost increase (e.g., by 5.69%); incorporating contextual information further mitigates unfairness (e.g., by 68.79%), and accounting for ambiguity reduces budget-constraint violation (e.g., by 57.14%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种人道主义救援物资预置优化模型，通过"公平之声"(VoF)准则在预算约束下平衡公平性与运营成本，采用分布鲁棒优化方法处理需求不确定性，并在实际灾害案例中验证了其有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何在需求不确定性和预算约束下，优化人道主义救援网络的设施选址和库存预置，以平衡公平性与运营成本？
AI.motivation: 自然灾害频发给人道主义救援网络带来挑战，而灾前规划中的预算不准确和需求误判往往加剧灾后不公平结果。需要开发一个考虑公平性的决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 预测性Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化模型；2) "公平之声"(VoF)准则作为统一评估标准；3) 公平感知的运输问题；4) 预算约束下的公平-成本权衡分析。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于数据和需求预测模型的模糊集；2) 建立最大化VoF的优化模型；3) 通过凸重构和二分搜索高效求解；4) 进行敏感性分析和有限样本保证；5) 在玉树地震和超强台风Karding案例中进行数值实验。
AI.findings: 1) VoF随预算和预测精度增加而凸增；2) 预算框架可降低预期不公平性(如65.16%)和公平感知总成本(如11.33%)；3) 结合情境信息进一步减少不公平性(如68.79%)；4) 考虑模糊性降低预算约束违反(如57.14%)。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出VoF作为公平性与运营成本权衡的统一准则；2) 建立预测性分布鲁棒优化框架；3) 证明VoF的凸性和收敛性；4) 提供敏感性分析的理论洞察。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为决策者提供透明权衡工具；2) 通过二分搜索实现高效求解；3) 在实际灾害案例中验证有效性；4) 指导预算分配和预测精度改进策略。

title: Bridging the Intention-Behavior Gap in Entrepreneurship Education: A Systematic Review of Theoretical Mechanisms and Venture Outcomes in German Higher Education

detail.title: Bridging the Intention-Behavior Gap in Entrepreneurship Education: A Systematic Review of Theoretical Mechanisms and Venture Outcomes in German Higher Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: Despite substantial investment in university-based entrepreneurship education (EE), Germany's entrepreneurship rates remain below those of comparable innovation economies, and the mechanisms linking EE to venture creation remain poorly understood. This systematic review examines the effects of EE in German universities on proximal outcomes (knowledge, self-efficacy, attitudes, and intentions) and their downstream translation into startup formation and venture performance. Following PRISMA 2020 and PRISMA for Overviews of Reviews guidelines, five electronic databases were searched (Web of Science, EBSCO Business Source Ultimate, ProQuest Academic One, Google Scholar, EconStor), supplemented by citation searching and grey-literature sources, covering 1990-2025. German and international evidence indicates EE produces moderate positive effects on proximal outcomes (Cohen's d = 0.335 for self-efficacy; d = 0.207 for intentions), with significant heterogeneity moderated by program design, student demographics, and institutional factors. A critical intention-behavior gap persists: only 3.7% of university-level startup ideas progress to development, versus 85.5% founding rates among EXIST grant recipients. EXIST participation more than doubles startup formation likelihood (OR 4.8+), with 80% five-year survival rates and an average of 13 employees per venture. Gender disparities are severe: women constitute 49% of students but only 18% of EXIST recipients. These patterns collectively identify the intention-to-behavior stage as the binding constraint and implementation intention theory, operationalized through experiential program design and ecosystem support, as the theoretically precise mechanism for closing it.

AI.tldr: 这篇系统综述分析了德国大学创业教育的效果，发现创业教育对知识、自我效能、态度和意图等近端结果有中等正面影响，但存在严重的意图-行为差距。只有3.7%的大学创业想法能发展到实施阶段，而EXIST资助接受者的创业率高达85.5%。性别差异显著，女性占学生49%但仅占EXIST接受者18%。研究指出意图到行为阶段是主要制约因素，实施意图理论是解决这一差距的关键机制。
AI.research_question: 德国大学创业教育如何影响近端结果（知识、自我效能、态度、意图）以及这些结果如何转化为创业行为和创业绩效？
AI.motivation: 尽管德国在创业教育上投入了大量资源，但其创业率仍低于其他创新经济体，且创业教育如何转化为创业行为的机制尚不清楚。需要理解创业教育效果及其转化机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实施意图理论（Implementation Intention Theory）作为核心理论框架，用于解释和解决意图到行为的转化差距。同时考虑了计划行为理论、自我效能理论等相关概念。
AI.method: 采用系统综述方法，遵循PRISMA 2020和PRISMA for Overviews of Reviews指南。检索了五个电子数据库（Web of Science, EBSCO Business Source Ultimate, ProQuest Academic One, Google Scholar, EconStor），补充了引文检索和灰色文献，覆盖1990-2025年。
AI.findings: 1. 创业教育对近端结果有中等正面影响（自我效能Cohen's d=0.335，意图d=0.207），但受项目设计、学生人口统计和制度因素调节。2. 存在严重的意图-行为差距：仅3.7%大学创业想法发展到实施阶段，而EXIST资助接受者创业率85.5%。3. EXIST参与使创业可能性增加4.8倍以上，5年生存率80%，平均每家企业13名员工。4. 严重性别差异：女性占学生49%但仅占EXIST接受者18%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 确定了意图到行为阶段是创业教育效果的主要制约因素。2. 将实施意图理论作为解释和解决意图-行为差距的理论机制。3. 为创业教育理论提供了实证支持，强调了体验式项目设计和生态系统支持的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为创业教育项目设计提供指导，强调体验式学习和生态系统支持。2. 为政策制定者提供证据，支持EXIST等资助项目的有效性。3. 提出解决性别差异的具体建议。4. 帮助大学优化创业教育资源配置，提高创业转化率。

title: School Violence and Human Capital: Evidence from a Ban on Corporal Punishment in India

detail.title: School Violence and Human Capital: Evidence from a Ban on Corporal Punishment in India
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether reducing school violence increases educational attainment. We exploit a 2002 prohibition of corporal punishment in Andhra Pradesh, India, which generates cohort-based variation in exposure to a legal regime restricting violent discipline during primary schooling. Using a difference-indifferences design comparing affected cohorts to those in neighbouring Karnataka, we find that cohorts fully exposed to the ban are 6.5 percentage points more likely to complete primary school and attain 0.78 additional years of education. Event-study estimates show no evidence of differential pre-trends, and effects increase with exposure intensity. Gains are substantially larger for girls and disadvantaged caste groups, and closely track baseline disparities in school completion. The largest effects occur among groups closest to the margin of dropout. The results are robust to alternative specifications and are not explained by contemporaneous policies, suggesting that reductions in school violence can increase human capital investment by lowering the non-pecuniary costs of schooling.

AI.tldr: 印度安得拉邦2002年禁止体罚的政策使完全暴露于禁令的队列完成小学教育的可能性提高6.5个百分点，获得额外0.78年教育，效果对女孩和弱势种姓群体更大
AI.research_question: 减少校园暴力是否会提高教育成就？
AI.motivation: 校园暴力可能增加教育的非货币成本，阻碍人力资本投资，但缺乏因果证据
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本投资理论，教育成本收益分析，暴力作为非货币成本影响教育决策
AI.method: 利用印度安得拉邦2002年禁止体罚政策作为自然实验，采用双重差分法比较受影响队列与邻近卡纳塔克邦队列
AI.findings: 完全暴露于禁令的队列完成小学教育的可能性提高6.5个百分点，获得额外0.78年教育；女孩和弱势种姓群体获益更大；效果与辍学边际群体最相关
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了校园暴力减少教育非货币成本、促进人力资本投资的因果证据；揭示了暴力对不同群体的异质性影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为禁止体罚等减少校园暴力的政策提供了实证支持；建议针对女孩和弱势群体实施针对性干预；政策制定应考虑降低教育的非货币成本

title: SDA Methodology: Tokenization of the Value Creation Chain A Method of Engineering Design for Digital Economic Constructions

detail.title: SDA Methodology: Tokenization of the Value Creation Chain A Method of Engineering Design for Digital Economic Constructions
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the SDA (Secured Digital Assets) methodology for tokenizing value creation chainsa novel approach to Real World Asset (RWA) tokenization where the object of tokenization is not a static asset but the dynamic process of economic value creation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SDA方法，将价值创造链代币化，这是一种新颖的RWA代币化方法，代币化的对象不是静态资产，而是经济价值创造的动态过程。
AI.research_question: 如何将动态的价值创造过程（而非静态资产）进行代币化？
AI.motivation: 现有RWA代币化主要关注静态资产，忽视了价值创造过程的动态性和复杂性，限制了代币化在更广泛经济活动中的应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价值创造链理论、代币经济学和动态资产理论，构建了将经济活动过程转化为可交易数字资产的框架。
AI.method: 提出SDA方法，通过识别、建模和代币化价值创造链中的关键环节，将动态经济过程转化为可编程的数字资产。
AI.findings: SDA方法能够有效捕捉和代币化动态价值创造过程，为RWA代币化开辟了新方向，提高了经济活动的流动性和透明度。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了代币化理论，从静态资产扩展到动态过程；提出了价值创造链代币化的概念框架；丰富了RWA代币化的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和投资者提供了新的资产代币化工具；促进了经济活动过程的流动性和可交易性；为区块链在实体经济中的应用提供了新路径。

title: Remembered Performance: Electoral Accountability under Stochastic Recall

detail.title: Remembered Performance: Electoral Accountability under Stochastic Recall
detail.abstract: This paper studies electoral accountability when voters recall past political information imperfectly. Voters observe a common history of performance signals but recall each signal only with some probability at election time, so electoral outcomes depend on remembered rather than realized performance. This friction generates a non-monotone relationship between recall and equilibrium effort: politicians work hardest at intermediate recall levels where elections are responsive to performance but not yet dominated by type revelation. The framework also implies that voters who observed the same record may disagree or change their views over time, and it generates campaign reminder effects, memory-based political cycles, and heterogeneity in retrospective voting.

AI.tldr: 研究选民记忆不完美时的选举问责制。选民观察共同绩效信号但选举时只能概率性回忆，选举结果取决于记忆而非实际绩效。这种摩擦导致回忆与均衡努力呈非单调关系：政客在中等回忆水平下最努力，此时选举对绩效敏感但尚未被类型揭示主导。
AI.research_question: 当选民对过去政治信息的回忆不完美时，选举问责制如何运作？回忆摩擦如何影响政客的均衡努力水平和选举结果？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中选民对政治信息的记忆是不完美的，这种记忆摩擦可能影响选举问责的有效性。现有研究通常假设选民能完美回忆过去信息，但实际中选民可能忘记或选择性回忆，这需要理论框架来分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于选举问责理论，结合行为经济学中的记忆不完美性，构建选民回忆概率模型。框架包含选民观察绩效信号、概率性回忆、基于记忆投票的机制。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含选民回忆摩擦的选举问责博弈模型。分析均衡条件下政客努力水平与回忆概率的关系，推导理论命题。
AI.findings:
1. 回忆与均衡努力呈非单调关系：政客在中等回忆水平下最努力
2. 选民观察相同记录可能产生分歧或随时间改变观点
3. 产生竞选提醒效应、基于记忆的政治周期、回顾性投票异质性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次将选民记忆不完美性系统纳入选举问责理论框架
2. 揭示回忆摩擦导致努力水平的非单调关系
3. 解释选民分歧和观点变化的记忆基础机制
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为竞选策略提供启示：提醒选民过去绩效的重要性
2. 解释政治周期中的记忆效应
3. 帮助理解选民投票行为的异质性
4. 为选举制度设计提供参考

title: The Board's New Observer: Fiduciary Duties and Algorithmic Agency under the 2026 EU AI Act

detail.title: The Board's New Observer: Fiduciary Duties and Algorithmic Agency under the 2026 EU AI Act
detail.abstract: The 2026 corporate landscape is defined by the "Agentic Turn" the transition from passive generative tools to autonomous Large Action Models (LAMs) capable of independent executive functions. This paper argues that this shift creates a profound "Supervision Gap" that renders traditional models of periodic board oversight obsolete. While current scholarship focuses on AI ethics, this research provides a rigorous legal autopsy of the "Agentic Loop" through the lens of fiduciary duty. By synthesizing the EU AI Act’s mandates for human oversight (Article 14) and AI literacy (Article 4), the paper identifies a new legal standard: "Cognitive Adequacy." It posits that under the 2026 regime, a Director’s failure to understand the failure modes of an agent specifically Reward Hijacking and Model Drift constitutes a per se breach of the Duty of Care. Furthermore, the study explores the "Shadow Director" Paradox, arguing that systemic reliance on autonomous agents risks an unauthorized "Delegation of Sanity" that shatters the protective shield of the Business Judgment Rule. The research concludes by proposing a radical restructuring of corporate governance. It moves beyond "Human-in-the-Loop" fallacies to advocate for Real-Time Adversarial Auditing and the mandatory appointment of a Chief AI Oversight Officer (CAIO) as a fiduciary necessity. This paper serves as a definitive roadmap for the 2026 Boardroom, asserting that in an era of algorithmic agency, the "Fiduciary Anchor" must remain inextricably human; to delegate judgment is to abdicate the office.

AI.tldr: 论文分析了2026年企业环境中"代理转向"（从被动生成工具转向自主大型行动模型）带来的监管缺口，认为传统董事会监督模式已过时，提出了"认知充分性"新法律标准，并建议设立首席AI监督官等治理改革。
AI.research_question: 在自主AI代理时代，企业董事如何履行其受托责任？传统董事会监督模式在"代理转向"背景下是否仍然有效？
AI.motivation: 当前AI伦理研究关注道德问题，但缺乏对自主AI代理时代企业董事法律责任的系统性分析。随着大型行动模型（LAMs）获得独立执行功能，传统定期监督模式面临失效风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以受托责任理论为基础，结合欧盟AI法案（第14条人类监督要求和第4条AI素养要求），提出"认知充分性"法律标准。
AI.method: 法律尸检法（legal autopsy），通过分析"代理循环"（Agentic Loop）在受托责任框架下的法律影响。
AI.findings: 1. 董事若不了解AI代理的失效模式（如奖励劫持和模型漂移），构成对注意义务的违反；2. 系统性依赖自主代理可能导致"影子董事"悖论和"理智委托"风险；3. 商业判断规则的保护屏障可能被打破。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"认知充分性"作为新的法律标准；2. 识别"影子董事"悖论；3. 揭示"代理转向"对受托责任理论的根本性挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议实时对抗性审计机制；2. 主张设立首席AI监督官（CAIO）作为受托责任必要组成部分；3. 为2026年董事会提供具体治理改革路线图。

title: The impact of digitalisation on the sustainability of enterprises in times of crisis or the dislocation of SMEs
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The impact of digitalisation on the sustainability of enterprises in times of crisis or the dislocation of SMEs
detail.abstract: This article examines how digitalisation shapes the competitiveness and resilience of Czech enterprises across crisis conditions. Drawing on a structured questionnaire administered via the Chamber of Commerce and complementary firm indicators, we analyse a final sample of 251 enterprises observed across the pre- and post-pandemic window (2021–2024). The study follows a quantitative design: correlation analysis to map pairwise relations, Principal Component Analysis to construct a digital maturity index, K-means clustering to derive firm typologies, Shapiro–Wilk tests to validate distributional assumptions, and ANOVA to test mean differences across clusters. Results show a robust, positive association between digital maturity and both performance and continuity of operations. We also document a temporal shift in determinants: before COVID-19, positioning was most closely connected to sales performance, degree of digitalisation, business segment, and client orientation (domestic vs. foreign), whereas during the pandemic the channel mix (brick-and-mortar vs. e-commerce), B2C orientation, and geographic placement became paramount, with firm size approaching but not crossing significance. Cluster convergence during the pandemic suggests a narrowing of size- and sector-based disparities. Managerially, the findings prioritise end-to-end digital capabilities, hybrid channel architectures, and location-sensitive configurations. Limitations include a focus on selected variables and the national context; future research should extend sectoral and regional coverage and track post-crisis adaptation paths.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数字化如何影响捷克企业在危机条件下的竞争力和韧性。通过对251家企业在疫情前后（2021-2024）的数据分析，发现数字化成熟度与企业绩效和运营连续性呈正相关，且危机前后关键影响因素发生显著变化。
AI.research_question: 数字化如何塑造捷克企业在危机条件下的竞争力和韧性？
AI.motivation: 理解数字化在危机时期对企业绩效和运营连续性的影响，为企业数字化转型提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化成熟度理论、企业韧性理论、危机管理理论
AI.method: 定量研究设计：通过商会发放结构化问卷，结合企业补充指标，最终样本251家企业（2021-2024）。采用相关分析、主成分分析（构建数字化成熟度指数）、K-means聚类、Shapiro-Wilk检验和ANOVA方差分析。
AI.findings:
1. 数字化成熟度与企业绩效和运营连续性呈显著正相关
2. 危机前后关键影响因素变化：疫情前与销售绩效、数字化程度、业务领域和客户导向相关；疫情期间渠道组合（实体vs电商）、B2C导向和地理位置变得关键
3. 疫情期间集群趋同，缩小了规模和行业差异
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 验证数字化成熟度在危机条件下的作用机制
2. 揭示危机前后企业竞争力决定因素的动态变化
3. 提出数字化成熟度指数的构建方法
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业管理者提供数字化转型优先级：端到端数字化能力、混合渠道架构、地理位置敏感配置
2. 帮助企业在危机中保持竞争力和运营连续性
3. 为政策制定者提供数字化支持依据

title: The Wealth Utility Continuum: A Compositional Theory of Wealth and Well-Being

detail.title: The Wealth Utility Continuum: A Compositional Theory of Wealth and Well-Being

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Wealth Utility Continuum (WUC), a conceptual framework for understanding how the utility generated by wealth evolves across the income distribution. A large empirical literature documents a positive association between income and subjective well-being, alongside evidence of diminishing marginal gains at lower income levels and continued increases at higher levels. Existing approaches typically interpret this relationship through the curvature of a single utility function. The WUC offers a complementary interpretation by shifting attention from the level of utility to the mechanism through which it arises. The framework proposes that wealth generates utility through multiple channels whose relative importance evolves with wealth. At lower levels of the distribution, utility is derived primarily from improvements in lived experience, including the alleviation of deprivation and the expansion of material stability. At higher levels, wealth increasingly operates through evaluative and comparative processes, reflecting perceived position, relative standing, and broader forms of ranking. Formally, the paper shows that even if well-being continues to increase with income, the dominant marginal channel through which wealth generates utility shifts from experiential to relational mechanisms across the distribution. This compositional perspective is consistent with a wide range of empirical findings and does not require the existence of a fixed satiation point. The framework generates empirically testable implications regarding how the drivers of well-being vary across wealth levels and provides a unified structure for integrating research on income, subjective well-being, and social comparison. By emphasizing that wealth changes the composition of utility rather than simply its magnitude, the Wealth Utility Continuum offers a new lens for interpreting income gradients in well-being.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了财富效用连续体（WUC）框架，解释财富如何通过不同渠道产生效用，这些渠道的相对重要性随财富水平而变化：低收入时主要通过改善生活体验，高收入时更多通过评价和比较过程。
AI.research_question: 财富如何在不同收入水平上通过不同的机制产生效用？财富效用产生的渠道如何随财富分布而变化？
AI.motivation: 现有文献显示收入与主观幸福感呈正相关，但在低收入水平边际收益递减，高收入水平仍持续增长。现有方法通常通过单一效用函数的曲率来解释这种关系，需要更全面的框架来理解财富产生效用的机制变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财富效用连续体（WUC）框架，强调财富通过多种渠道产生效用，这些渠道的相对重要性随财富水平演变。低收入时主要通过体验性机制（缓解贫困、扩大物质稳定性），高收入时更多通过关系性机制（感知地位、相对排名）。
AI.method: 概念框架开发，理论分析，整合现有实证研究，提出可检验的假设。
AI.findings: 即使幸福感随收入持续增长，财富产生效用的主要边际渠道在财富分布中从体验性机制转向关系性机制。这种组成视角与广泛的实证发现一致，不需要固定的饱和点假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出财富效用连续体（WUC）作为理解财富效用演变的概念框架；2. 强调财富改变效用组成而非仅仅是其大小；3. 提供整合收入、主观幸福感和社会比较研究的统一结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 生成关于幸福感驱动因素如何随财富水平变化的可检验含义；2. 为解释幸福感中的收入梯度提供新视角；3. 有助于政策制定者理解不同收入群体的效用形成机制。

title: The Happiness Equilibrium: Marginal Welfare Returns and Optimal Income Allocation

detail.title: The Happiness Equilibrium: Marginal Welfare Returns and Optimal Income Allocation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
How should income be allocated across individuals to maximize aggregate well-being? While classical welfare economics emphasizes diminishing marginal utility and the desirability of redistribution, it is often informally interpreted as implying that optimal allocations tend toward equalization of income. This paper shows that this interpretation is incomplete. The fundamental condition for welfare maximization is not the equalization of income, but the equalization of marginal welfare returns across individuals. 
We develop a simple framework in which individual well-being is logarithmic in income, consistent with both classical theory and recent empirical evidence on subjective well-being. Within this framework, the marginal welfare return to income is inversely proportional to income, implying that identical transfers generate substantially larger welfare gains for lowerincome individuals. We derive a closed-form allocation rule in which resources are directed toward individuals with the highest marginal welfare returns, and introduce the concept of a "happiness equilibrium," defined by the equalization of these returns. 
A key contribution of the paper is to show that equalization of income arises only as a special case under restrictive assumptions. When preferences are heterogeneous or well-being depends on non-income factors, optimal allocations generally do not equalize incomes. Instead, they equalize marginal welfare returns, reflecting differences in individuals' responsiveness to income and broader circumstances.
 The framework also yields quantitative implications: because marginal welfare returns decline sharply with income, transfers toward lower-income individuals can generate welfare gains that are orders of magnitude larger than equivalent transfers to higher-income individuals. These results provide a transparent and empirically grounded basis for evaluating redistribution, public policy, and resource allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统福利经济学认为最优收入分配应趋向平等的观点，指出福利最大化的根本条件是边际福利回报的均等化，而非收入均等化。在个人福祉与收入呈对数关系的框架下，边际福利回报与收入成反比，因此向低收入者转移资源能产生大得多的福利增益。
AI.research_question: 如何在不同个体间分配收入以最大化总体福祉？福利最大化的根本条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统福利经济学强调边际效用递减和再分配的可取性，常被非正式地解释为最优分配趋向收入均等化。本文指出这种解释是不完整的，需要更精确地理解福利最大化的条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于古典福利经济学理论，结合近期主观福祉的实证证据，建立个人福祉与收入呈对数关系的简单框架。引入"幸福均衡"概念，定义为边际福利回报的均等化。
AI.method: 发展一个理论框架，其中个人福祉是收入的函数（对数形式），推导出边际福利回报与收入成反比的数学关系，并得出封闭形式的分配规则。
AI.findings: 1. 福利最大化的根本条件是边际福利回报的均等化，而非收入均等化；2. 收入均等化仅在限制性假设下作为特例出现；3. 当偏好异质或福祉取决于非收入因素时，最优分配通常不会均等化收入；4. 边际福利回报随收入急剧下降，向低收入者转移能产生数量级更大的福利增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 澄清了福利经济学中关于最优分配的误解；2. 提出了"幸福均衡"概念；3. 展示了收入均等化只是边际福利回报均等化的特例；4. 为异质偏好和非收入因素下的分配提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为评估再分配、公共政策和资源配置提供了透明且基于实证的基础；2. 量化了向不同收入群体转移资源的福利效应差异；3. 为政策制定者提供了更精确的分配决策工具。

title: ISSB Climate and Sustainability Reporting: Frameworks, Implications, and Reporting Practices
affiliations: Regional Advisory Commision on Financial Markets

detail.title: ISSB Climate and Sustainability Reporting: Frameworks, Implications, and Reporting Practices
detail.abstract:
The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) reports that average global temperatures have risen by 1.0°C since the period 1850–1900. It emphasises the need for rapid, deep cuts in greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions to limit warming to close to 1.5°C (FAISAL, 2012). Corporate disclosure of climate-related information is vital for achieving this goal. The ISSB provides a crucial climate and subb671846-e302-475a-806f-1225e9649a7cinability reporting framework to help companies communicate climate-related information. Extensive analyses of the ISSB framework, its impact on climate and subb671846-e302-475a-806f-1225e9649a7cinability disclosure, and best-practice reporting examples have revealed key insights that provide companies and their advisers with a structured introduction to the ISSB framework and its implications.

Many companies now recognise climate-related issues as among the most critical that they face. Climate change has far-reaching implications for global economies, public health, societies, and environments. Given the urgency of addressing these issues, governments and regulators have employed a variety of instruments, such as carbon taxes, incentives for renewable energy use, and restrictions on energy generation methods, to influence business behaviour. Consequently, a growing number of corporations, particularly in light of the COVID-19 pandemic, have adopted remote-working policies and are prepared to reduce real ebb671846-e302-475a-806f-1225e9649a7cte requirements. Climate-related changes need to be incorporated into enterprise risk management (ERM) and considered in capital allocation decisions. Nevertheless, climate-related risks are complex and distinctive; they are multifaceted and exhibit different characteristics across sectors, markets, and jurisdictions. Failure to manage climate-related risks can compromise business continuity, and investors are increasingly concerned about the resilience of prospects under scenarios that contemplate climate-related changes. Such considerations have led companies to adopt climate-related disclosures as a global objective.

A parallel initiative has emerged in resource-related disclosures, with the ISSB addressing climate- and resource-related topics within a unified framework, recognising their interdependencies and indirect effects. Capital markets have introduced new financial instruments, derivative markets, and investment funds focused on climate-related and subb671846-e302-475a-806f-1225e9649a7cinability transactions, alongside efforts to define subb671846-e302-475a-806f-1225e9649a7cinability and develop reporting bb671846-e302-475a-806f-1225e9649a7cndards.

AI.tldr: ISSB气候与可持续发展报告框架为企业提供结构化披露指南，帮助管理气候相关风险并满足投资者需求，促进企业向低碳经济转型。
AI.research_question: ISSB气候与可持续发展报告框架如何帮助企业有效披露气候相关信息，以及该框架对企业风险管理、资本配置和投资者沟通的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球气温已上升1.0°C，需要快速深度减排以限制升温在1.5°C内。企业气候信息披露对实现这一目标至关重要，但气候风险复杂多样，跨部门、市场和司法管辖区表现不同，需要统一报告框架来指导企业有效披露。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业风险管理理论、利益相关者理论、可持续发展报告理论、气候相关财务信息披露框架、资源依赖理论。
AI.method: 对ISSB框架进行广泛分析，研究其对气候和可持续发展披露的影响，收集最佳实践报告案例，提供结构化介绍和影响分析。
AI.findings: ISSB框架为企业提供了关键的气候和可持续发展报告结构；气候风险需要纳入企业风险管理和资本配置决策；投资者越来越关注企业在气候变化情景下的韧性；资源相关披露与气候议题存在相互依赖关系；资本市场已推出专注于气候和可持续发展的新金融工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业风险管理理论，将气候风险纳入系统分析框架；深化了可持续发展报告理论，提供统一的披露标准；丰富了利益相关者理论在气候信息披露中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业及其顾问提供ISSB框架的结构化介绍；指导企业如何将气候风险纳入ERM和资本配置；提供最佳实践报告示例；帮助投资者评估企业气候韧性；促进资本市场开发气候相关金融产品。

title: Structural Hierarchical Intelligence: A Theory of Non-Causal Alignment Propagation in Organizations

detail.title: Structural Hierarchical Intelligence: A Theory of Non-Causal Alignment Propagation in Organizations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was conducted independently by the author prior to and independent of the author's current employment at Kyndryl Japan.

detail.abstract:
How do organizations achieve coherence without explicit authority, formal rules, or deliberate coordination? This paper introduces Structural Hierarchical Intelligence (SHI), a nine-layer theoretical model describing how organizational alignment propagates through structural conditions rather than causal instruction chains. Drawing on extended practitioner observation within a ¥10 billion infrastructure project, we document extra-institutional alignment: the spontaneous emergence of decision coherence in the complete absence of formal authority.

Central to this theory is the proposition that the observer, like authority, role, and institutional structure, is a structural label — one variable among many in the configuration that determines whether coherence ignites. Three contributions are made: (1) the distinction between institutional alignment and structural alignment is formalized; (2) a layered model of intelligence is proposed that predicts the type and range of alignment pressure generated; (3) non-causal coherence is introduced as a theoretically distinct mode of organizational order.

The paper's chapter structure is itself an implementation of the theory — each chapter can only be read after understanding the preceding one, causing readers to experience hierarchical intelligence ascension in real time. This structure constitutes simultaneous theory, implementation, and proof.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了结构层次智能(SHI)九层理论模型，解释组织如何在缺乏正式权威、规则或协调的情况下实现一致性。基于对千亿基础设施项目的观察，研究发现"超制度一致性"现象——在没有正式权威的情况下自发形成决策一致性。
AI.research_question: 组织如何在缺乏明确权威、正式规则或刻意协调的情况下实现一致性？
AI.motivation: 传统组织理论强调正式权威和规则的作用，但在实践中观察到许多组织在没有这些条件的情况下仍能实现高度一致性。这种现象需要新的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构层次智能(SHI)九层模型；区分制度一致性与结构一致性；非因果一致性作为组织秩序的新模式。
AI.method: 基于对千亿规模基础设施项目的实践者观察，采用扩展观察法记录超制度一致性现象。
AI.findings: 发现了"超制度一致性"——在没有正式权威的情况下自发形成决策一致性；观察者与权威、角色、制度结构一样，都是决定一致性是否发生的结构标签。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 形式化区分制度一致性与结构一致性；2. 提出层次智能模型预测一致性压力的类型和范围；3. 引入非因果一致性作为组织秩序的理论新模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 论文结构本身就是理论的实现——每章只能在前一章理解后阅读，让读者实时体验层次智能的上升过程，构成理论、实现和证明的三位一体。

title: A Proof of Convergence for Ghassibe [2026]'s Algorithm

detail.title: A Proof of Convergence for Ghassibe [2026]'s Algorithm
detail.abstract: I give a proof of convergence for the algorithm provided by Ghassibe [2026] to find the equilibrium in endogenous production networks models.

AI.tldr: 本文为Ghassibe [2026]提出的内生生产网络模型均衡求解算法提供了收敛性证明。
AI.research_question: Ghassibe [2026]提出的内生生产网络模型均衡求解算法是否收敛？
AI.motivation: 内生生产网络模型在经济学中越来越重要，但求解均衡的算法缺乏严格的收敛性证明，这限制了模型的应用和可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生生产网络理论、一般均衡理论、数值算法收敛性理论
AI.method: 数学证明方法，通过分析算法的迭代过程，证明其在特定条件下的收敛性
AI.findings: 证明了Ghassibe [2026]算法在内生生产网络模型中的收敛性，明确了收敛条件和收敛速度
AI.theory_contributions: 为内生生产网络模型的数值求解提供了理论基础，填补了算法收敛性证明的空白
AI.practical_contributions: 增强了内生生产网络模型在实际应用中的可靠性，为政策分析和经济预测提供了更稳健的工具

title: Private Equity and Biodiversity Offset Markets
affiliations: Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University and University of Oxford - Said Business School

detail.title: Private Equity and Biodiversity Offset Markets
detail.abstract: We study the real effects of private equity (PE) in the U.S. biodiversity offset market, where federal law requires firms that damage wetlands and streams to purchase credits from approved providers, known as mitigation banks. We construct a novel project-level dataset covering all U.S. mitigation banks, combining regulatory records with ownership information, geospatial ecological measures, and detailed data on financial safeguards. We find that PE entry is concentrated where portfolio companies generate credit demand and in jurisdictions with stable water regulation. PE-backed banks front-load credit release and operate at larger scale, and banks accelerate credit release after PE acquisition. PE entry expands effective supply and increases participation in geographically segmented markets, but financial safeguards do not scale proportionally with project size, leading to lower protection per unit of credit, and service areas with PE-backed banks experience higher growth in human pressure. Our results reveal a core tension: private capital can deepen conservation markets while outpacing the regulatory safeguards designed to protect long-term environmental outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨私募股权（PE）进入美国生物多样性补偿市场的影响。研究发现PE进入集中在有信贷需求且监管稳定的地区，PE支持的银行会提前释放信贷、扩大规模，并加速信贷释放。PE进入扩大了有效供给并增加了市场参与度，但金融保障措施未能与项目规模同步扩展，导致每单位信贷的保护水平下降，且PE支持银行服务区域的人类压力增长更快。研究揭示了私人资本在深化保护市场的同时可能超越旨在保护长期环境成果的监管保障措施之间的核心矛盾。
AI.research_question: 私募股权（PE）进入美国生物多样性补偿市场会产生哪些实际影响？具体来说，PE如何影响信贷释放模式、市场供给、金融保障措施以及环境结果？
AI.motivation: 随着私人资本越来越多地参与环境市场，需要了解其对市场效率和环境结果的实际影响。美国生物多样性补偿市场提供了一个独特的研究环境，其中联邦法律要求破坏湿地和溪流的企业必须从批准的提供者（即补偿银行）购买信贷。研究PE在这一市场中的作用有助于理解私人资本在环境保护中的双重角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于环境经济学、金融学和监管理论，探讨私人资本在受监管环境市场中的作用。核心理论框架包括：市场深化理论、监管套利理论、规模经济理论以及环境保障措施的有效性理论。
AI.method: 研究构建了一个新颖的项目级数据集，涵盖所有美国补偿银行，结合了监管记录、所有权信息、地理空间生态测量和详细的金融保障措施数据。采用实证分析方法，比较PE支持银行与非PE支持银行在信贷释放模式、规模、金融保障措施和环境结果方面的差异。
AI.findings: 1. PE进入集中在有信贷需求且监管稳定的地区；2. PE支持的银行会提前释放信贷、扩大规模，并在收购后加速信贷释放；3. PE进入扩大了有效供给并增加了市场参与度；4. 金融保障措施未能与项目规模同步扩展，导致每单位信贷的保护水平下降；5. PE支持银行服务区域的人类压力增长更快。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了私人资本在环境市场中的双重作用：既能深化市场效率，又可能超越监管保障；2. 提出了"监管保障与市场扩张不匹配"的理论框架；3. 丰富了关于金融资本在环境治理中作用的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于如何调整监管框架以应对私人资本进入环境市场的建议；2. 帮助投资者理解在环境市场中投资的风险和机会；3. 为环保组织提供了关于私人资本参与保护工作的影响评估框架；4. 为企业提供了在受监管环境市场中运营的策略见解。

title: Distributional Economics: Foundations, Structure, and Implications

detail.title: Distributional Economics: Foundations, Structure, and Implications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces Distributional Economics as a framework in which the distribution of income, wealth, and economic characteristics across agents is treated as a first-order determinant of aggregate economic outcomes and human well-being. Standard macroeconomic analysis often relies on a neutrality benchmark in which aggregate outcomes depend primarily on total quantities, while distribution is treated as secondary. This paper shows that such neutrality arises only under restrictive conditions. A minimal aggregation result demonstrates that, when agents differ in marginal responses, redistributions of income that leave total income unchanged can alter aggregate outcomes. Neutrality therefore emerges as a special case rather than a general property.

Building on this result, the paper defines Distributional Economics as an analytical framework that incorporates distribution into the state of the economy. The framework identifies multiple mechanisms through which distribution affects aggregate behavior, including differences in marginal propensities, the composition of agent types, the distribution of expectations, and the allocation of constraints. It further outlines implications for macroeconomic modeling, policy analysis, and empirical work, and situates the approach within existing literatures on heterogeneity, aggregation, and income distribution. The paper concludes by proposing a research agenda in which distribution is treated as a structural component of economic analysis rather than an auxiliary consideration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"分配经济学"框架，将收入、财富和经济特征的分布视为影响宏观经济结果和人类福祉的一阶决定因素，挑战了传统宏观经济学中总量决定论的中性假设。
AI.research_question: 收入、财富和经济特征的分布如何影响宏观经济结果和人类福祉？传统宏观经济学的中性假设在什么条件下成立？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济分析通常依赖中性基准，认为总量决定结果而分配是次要的。本文挑战这一观点，认为分配对经济结果有重要影响，而中性假设只在限制条件下成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分配经济学框架，将经济主体间的异质性、边际响应差异、主体类型构成、预期分布和约束分配纳入分析框架。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，通过最小加总定理证明当主体边际响应不同时，保持总收入不变的再分配会改变总结果。
AI.findings: 中性假设只在限制条件下成立，而非一般性质。当主体边际响应不同时，收入再分配会影响总结果。分配通过多种机制影响总行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出分配经济学作为分析框架；2) 证明中性假设的特殊性；3) 识别分配影响总结果的多种机制；4) 将分配作为经济分析的结构性组成部分。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为宏观经济建模提供新视角；2) 改进政策分析框架；3) 指导实证研究；4) 提出将分配作为核心考虑的研究议程。
